title: NSM — Response
description: Phase 6: automated blocking — decisions, the active block list, firewall changes and time to block.

list.name: mode
list.label: Responder mode
list.description: enforce = rows that changed the real firewall; dry-run = what would have happened

panels.title: Active blocks

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS active FROM (SELECT ip, argMax(action, created_at) AS last_action, argMax(tuple(expires_at), created_at).1 AS until, argMax(trigger, created_at) AS last_trigger, argMax(rule, created_at) AS last_rule, argMax(reason, created_at) AS last_reason, max(created_at) AS decided FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND action IN ('block', 'release') GROUP BY ip) WHERE last_action = 'block' AND until > now64(3)

panels.description: IPs currently in the block list for the selected mode (dry-run: the list the rule would have)

panels.title: Blocks

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS blocks FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND action = 'block' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.description: Block decisions in the time range (automatic and manual)

panels.title: Observed

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS observed FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND action = 'observe' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.description: Alerts from observe-only triggers (RSP-003): recorded, never blocked

panels.title: Rejected

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS rejected FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND action = 'reject' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.description: Refused decisions: never-block list, private or invalid addresses, suppression, caps

panels.title: Median evidence → block

targets.rawSql: SELECT median(dateDiff('millisecond', a.evidence_at, p.applied_at)) / 1000 AS seconds FROM nsm.response_actions AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT applied_at, arrayJoin(added) AS range FROM nsm.response_applies WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND result != 'error') AS p ON p.range = concat(a.ip, '/32') WHERE a.mode = '${mode}' AND a.action = 'block' AND a.evidence_at IS NOT NULL AND p.applied_at >= a.created_at AND $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND (a.mode != 'enforce' OR parseDateTime64BestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(a.detail, 'startsAt')) >= a.created_at - INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)

panels.description: MTTR as defined in docs/kpi.md: first evidence of the activity → the firewall rule containing the IP (dry-run: when the list would have been pushed). Enforce-mode blocks decided from a repeat notification of an older alert are excluded (docs/kpi.md)

panels.title: Last reconciler result

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(argMax(result, applied_at), ' · ', toString(dateDiff('minute', max(applied_at), now64(3))), ' min ago') AS last FROM nsm.response_applies WHERE mode = '${mode}'

panels.description: Latest firewall change (or error). The reconciler only writes a row when the list changes

targets.rawSql: SELECT ip, last_trigger AS trigger, last_rule AS rule, last_reason AS reason, decided AS blocked_at, until AS expires_at, dateDiff('minute', now64(3), until) AS minutes_left FROM (SELECT ip, argMax(action, created_at) AS last_action, argMax(tuple(expires_at), created_at).1 AS until, argMax(trigger, created_at) AS last_trigger, argMax(rule, created_at) AS last_rule, argMax(reason, created_at) AS last_reason, max(created_at) AS decided FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND action IN ('block', 'release') GROUP BY ip) WHERE last_action = 'block' AND until > now64(3) ORDER BY blocked_at DESC

panels.title: Decisions over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(created_at) AS time, action, count() AS decisions FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time, action ORDER BY time

panels.description: block / observe / reject / release per interval

panels.title: Rejections by reason

targets.rawSql: SELECT replaceRegexpOne(reason, ' until .*| \\(.*\\)$', '') AS reason, count() AS decisions, uniqExact(ip) AS ips, max(created_at) AS last FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND action = 'reject' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY reason ORDER BY decisions DESC

panels.description: Why the policy refused to block: a guard rail working, or a trigger that needs tuning

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, action, ip, trigger, rule, reason, expires_at, actor FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Time to block per IP

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.ip AS ip, a.trigger AS trigger, a.evidence_at AS evidence_at, a.created_at AS decided_at, min(p.applied_at) AS applied_at, round(dateDiff('millisecond', a.evidence_at, min(p.applied_at)) / 1000, 1) AS evidence_to_block_s, round(dateDiff('millisecond', a.created_at, min(p.applied_at)) / 1000, 1) AS decision_to_block_s FROM nsm.response_actions AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT applied_at, arrayJoin(added) AS range FROM nsm.response_applies WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND result != 'error') AS p ON p.range = concat(a.ip, '/32') WHERE a.mode = '${mode}' AND a.action = 'block' AND p.applied_at >= a.created_at AND $__timeFilter(a.created_at) GROUP BY a.ip, a.trigger, a.evidence_at, a.created_at ORDER BY decided_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: evidence_at: first matching event in ClickHouse; applied_at: reconciler confirmed the rule (enforce) or recorded the would-be list (dry-run)

panels.title: Firewall changes

targets.rawSql: SELECT applied_at, result, length(ranges) AS listed, arrayStringConcat(added, ' ') AS added, arrayStringConcat(removed, ' ') AS removed, duration_ms, error FROM nsm.response_applies WHERE mode = '${mode}' AND $__timeFilter(applied_at) ORDER BY applied_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: What the reconciler pushed to the nsm-blocklist VPC firewall rule (nsm.response_applies)
